guidebook.intro: Goberera amawulire, yogera mu lukiiko, era owe endowooza yo mu Lungereza.

tips.title: Have you heard?
body: **Owulide amawulire?** kiba **Have you heard the news?** Okudamu: **Yes, I heard it on the radio.** (**hear → heard**).

tips.title: He says that …
body: **Agamba ti** kiba **he says that**: **He says that rain is coming.** **They say that the new road is finished.** Abantu batera okuleka **that**: **They say the road is finished.**

tips.title: Endowooza
body: **I think that it is good.** **I agree with you.** **I don’t agree.** Okubuuza endowooza: **What is your opinion?** oba **What do you think?**

culture.title: Leediyo
body: Mu Uganda abantu bangi bawulira amawulire ku leediyo era bakubira esimu ku pulogulaamu. Mu Lungereza: **a talk show**, **a caler**, **the presenter**.
